desc: incremental Zobrist hashing in make() + make_light() for legality-only copies
note: Board.hash maintained incrementally by make() (XOR exactly what changed) instead of every negamax node recomputing from scratch. First attempt was SLOWER (1.28->1.33s) because gen_legal()'s throwaway legality-test copies were paying for hash upkeep they never use; added make_light() (piece placement only, no hash/castle/ep/side) for that path. Net: 1.28->~1.22s (-5%), node count BYTE-IDENTICAL (1,401,527, confirming search shape unchanged - no strength gate needed, same as the s5 eval cache). Verified: perft unchanged, hash-verify walks 350k+ positions with zero mismatches against a from-scratch recompute (tests/test_core.py), eval cross-check still 0.000000, all 46 tests pass, UCI smoke test clean.
